cases.name: Deborah Martha “Debbie” Pooley
cases.about: Her Find a Grave said: "In the early 1980s she went to work as a bartender at Dalts, a popular eatery and bar in Kendall, a suburb of Miami, Florida. Debbie earned the nickname "Mom" from co-workers who turned to her for advice about relationships, college and the future. She left Miami for the suburbs of Cincinnati, Ohio in the mid-1980s looking for a safer place in a smaller city and to be near her parents. Debbie got a job as an assistant manager at a restaurant called Barleycorn's Yacht Club."
cases.narrative:
Wilson and a female accomplice, his girlfriend Brenda Humphreys, abducted her at knifepoint after she parked her car outside her apartment, and forced her into the back seat of her own car. He made her unbutton her blouse, then finished undressing her and raped her. He then tied her hands with a lamp cord, and the she began begging for her life. Wilson told her she would have to die. Humphrey said, "You have seen us. You know who we are, and you have to die." Deborah kept begging, "Please don't kill me. I don't want to die." Wilson robbed her and strangled her to death before they crossed the state line into Indiana.

Wilson and Humphrey disposed of her naked body in a wooded thicket in rural Hendrix County, IN. On 6/15/1987, members of the Hendrix County, IN Sheriff's Department found her body. Authorities were able to identity her only by comparing her remaining teeth with her dental X-rays. The cause of death could not be determined due to the absence of internal organs. A forensic entomologist testified that, based on the extent of blowfly maggot development in and on the corpse, the estimated time of death had occurred 15 to 19 days prior to his 6/16 examination of her body.

cases.name: Kierra Brianna Lane
cases.about: She was born in Edgewood, Kentucky.  "She was a beautiful person. She was like my older sister I never had," (friend Kaleena) Morison said. As reality sets in, (her sister, Nivea) Conrad mourns the loss of her best friend and seeks justice for the sister she looked up to. "She was so beautiful, and bright and she was going to be successful and I don't think he could take that," Conrad said.
cases.narrative:
Lane's sister, Nivea Conrad, says she was at Kierra's home when all of this happened. "I watched Mario Payne kill my sister," Conrad said. Conrad and Kaleena Morison were staying at Lane's home in Covington Saturday. Conrad says Lane wanted company when the father of her children, Mario Payne, was stopping by to pick up their kids. "She felt something was going to happen. She felt something was wrong and that's why she brought us along with her," Conrad said.

Conrad and Morison said when Payne got to the house, he had a different plan. "He was supposed to take the babies for a couple hours and that's all we thought it was," Conrad said. According to court documents, Payne grabbed a gun and shot Lane multiple times in front of their children, who are 11 months old and 2 years old.

"He walked away and laughed in my face after he took my sister's life," Conrad said.
